'''The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Red''' is the first of two compilation volumes of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}} released by [[VIZ Media]]. This volume contains a selection of chapters from the {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}. As a result of this, many key events (including much of the Team Rocket storyline) are left out. This sometimes leads to references to events that are not included in this volume. The chapters come directly from VIZ Media's first edition translation of the series.

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Red}} catches a {{p|Nidorino}}.
* Red meets {{adv|Blue}}.
* Red receives a {{p|Bulbasaur}} and a [[Pokédex]] from Professor Oak.
* Red catches a [[Pika]]chu.
* Red and {{adv|Blue}} meet [[Brock]] and win the {{badge|Boulder}}.
* Red meets {{adv|Green}}.
* Red learns that {{p|Squirtle}}, the third first partner Pokémon, was stolen.
* Red disguises as a {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}} and infiltrates their headquarters.
* Team Rocket tries to capture Green as she had stolen their {{p|Mew}} disc.
* Red attempts to obtain [[HM03]] {{m|Surf}}, but ultimately fails.
* [[Misty]] gives her {{p|Gyarados}}, [[Gyara]], to Red and takes his {{p|Krabby}} in exchange.
* Red arrives at [[Seafoam Islands]] and meets {{p|Articuno}}.
* Red encounters [[Team Rocket]], who are trying to capture Articuno.
* Green, {{adv|Professor Oak|Dr. O}}, Red, and Blue reach the semi-finals of the Indigo League tournament.
* Green becomes a [[Pokédex holder]].
* Red defeats Blue in the finals and becomes the [[Pokémon Champion|Pokémon League Champion]].
